title: Schedule entry
description: One entry's value in the 'schedule' state document. The entry's id is its object key in /config/schedule.json, not a field in this value.

message.description: What the agent should do when this fires.

cron_expression.description: Cron expression for a recurring schedule. Set exactly one of cron_expression/scheduled_at, leave the other null.

scheduled_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp for a one-off schedule. Set exactly one of cron_expression/scheduled_at, leave the other null.

timezone.description: IANA timezone cron_expression/scheduled_at is interpreted in.

paused.description: Whether this entry is suspended (skips firing without deleting it).

user_request.description: The original natural-language request that created this schedule.
